1.zh: 大卫的儿子所罗门国位坚固；耶和华 ─ 他的神与他同在，使他甚为尊大。
1.en: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the Lord his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.

1.zh: 所罗门吩咐以色列众人，就是千夫长 、 百夫长 、 审判官 、 首领与族长都来。
1.en: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel-to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families-

1.zh: 所罗门和会众都往基遍的邱坛去，因那里有神的会幕，就是耶和华仆人摩西在旷野所制造的。
1.en: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God's Tent of Meeting was there, which Moses the Lord 's servant had made in the desert.

1.zh: 只是神的约柜，大卫已经从基列耶琳搬到他所预备的地方，因他曾在耶路撒冷为约柜支搭了帐幕，
1.en: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

1.zh: 并且户珥的孙子 、 乌利的儿子比撒列所造的铜坛也在基遍耶和华的会幕前。所罗门和会众都就近坛前。
1.en: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the Lord ; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.

1.zh: 所罗门上到耶和华面前会幕的铜坛那里，献一千牺牲为燔祭。
1.en: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the Lord in the Tent of Meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

1.zh: 当夜，神向所罗门显现，对他说：你愿我赐你甚么，你可以求。
1.en: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

1.zh: 所罗门对神说：你曾向我父大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。
1.en: Solomon answered God, "You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.

1.zh: 耶和华神啊，现在求你成就向我父大卫所应许的话；因你立我作这民的王，他们如同地上尘沙那样多。
1.en: Now, Lord God, let your promise to my father David be confirmed, for you have made me king over a people who are as numerous as the dust of the earth.

1.zh: 求你赐我智慧聪明，我好在这民前出入；不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？
1.en: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

1.zh: 神对所罗门说：我已立你作我民的王。你既有这心意，并不求资财 、 丰富 、 尊荣，也不求灭绝那恨你之人的性命，又不求大寿数，只求智慧聪明好判断我的民；
1.en: God said to Solomon, "Since this is your heart's desire and you have not asked for wealth, riches or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,

1.zh: 我必赐你智慧聪明，也必赐你资财 、 丰富 、 尊荣。在你以前的列王都没有这样，在你以后也必没有这样的。
1.en: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, riches and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have."

1.zh: 于是，所罗门从基遍邱坛会幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
1.en: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting. And he reigned over Israel.

1.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
1.en: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

1.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使金银多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
1.en: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

1.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按著定价买来的。
1.en: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue - the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.

1.zh: 他们从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百舍客勒，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。
1.en: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

2.zh: 所罗门定意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
2.en: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the Lord and a royal palace for himself.

2.zh: 所罗门就挑选七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的，三千六百督工的。
2.en: He conscripted seventy thousand men as carriers and eighty thousand as stonecutters in the hills and thirty-six hundred as foremen over them.

2.zh: 所罗门差人去见推罗王希兰，说：你曾运香柏木与我父大卫建宫居住，求你也这样待我。
2.en: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: "Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.

2.zh: 我要为耶和华 ─ 我神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧美香，常摆陈设饼，每早晚 、 安息日 、 月朔，并耶和华 ─ 我们神所定的节期献燔祭。这是以色列人永远的定例。
2.en: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on Sabbaths and New Moons and at the appointed feasts of the Lord our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.

2.zh: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因为我们的神至大，超乎诸神。
2.en: "The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.

2.zh: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，谁能为他建造殿宇呢？我是谁？能为他建造殿宇吗？不过在他面前烧香而已。
2.en: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?

2.zh: 现在求你差一个巧匠来，就是善用金 、 银 、 铜 、 铁，和紫色 、 朱红色 、 蓝色线，并精于雕刻之工的巧匠，与我父大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷所预备的巧匠一同做工；
2.en: "Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled craftsmen, whom my father David provided.

2.zh: 又求你从利巴嫩运些香柏木 、 松木 、 檀香木到我这里来，因我知道你的仆人善于砍伐利巴嫩的树木。我的仆人也必与你的仆人同工。
2.en: "Send me also cedar, pine and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your men are skilled in cutting timber there. My men will work with yours

2.zh: 这样，可以给我预备许多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
2.en: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.

2.zh: 你的仆人砍伐树木，我必给他们打好了的小麦二万歌珥，大麦二万歌珥，酒二万罢特，油二万罢特。
2.en: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil."

2.zh: 推罗王希兰写信回答所罗门说：耶和华因为爱他的子民，所以立你作他们的王；
2.en: Hiram king of Tyre replied by letter to Solomon: "Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you their king."

2.zh: 又说：创造天地的耶和华 ─ 以色列的神是应当称颂的！他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，使他有谋略聪明，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
2.en: And Hiram added: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.

2.zh: 现在我打发一个精巧有聪明的人去，他是我父亲希兰所用的，
2.en: "I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,

2.zh: 是但支派一个妇人的儿子。他父亲是推罗人，他善用金 、 银 、 铜 、 铁 、 石 、 木，和紫色 、 蓝色 、 朱红色线与细麻制造各物，并精于雕刻，又能想出各样的巧工。请你派定这人，与你的巧匠和你父 ─ 我主大卫的巧匠一同做工。
2.en: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my Lord , David your father.

2.zh: 我主所说的小麦 、 大麦 、 酒 、 油，愿我主运来给众仆人。
2.en: "Now let my Lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,

2.zh: 我们必照你所需用的，从利巴嫩砍伐树木，扎成筏子，浮海运到约帕；你可以从那里运到耶路撒冷。
2.en: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them in rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem."

2.zh: 所罗门仿照他父大卫数点住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五万三千六百名；
2.en: Solomon took a census of all the aliens who were in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.

2.zh: 使七万人扛抬材料，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人督理工作。
2.en: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.

3.zh: 所罗门就在耶路撒冷 、 耶和华向他父大卫显现的摩利亚山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上 、 大卫所指定的地方预备好了，开工建造耶和华的殿。
3.en: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.

3.zh: 所罗门作王第四年二月初二日开工建造。
3.en: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.

3.zh: 所罗门建筑神殿的根基，乃是这样：长六十肘，宽二十肘，都按著古时的尺寸。
3.en: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).

3.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，高一百二十肘；里面贴上精金。
3.en: The portico at the front of the temple was twenty cubits long across the width of the building and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.

3.zh: 大殿的墙都用松木板遮蔽，又贴了精金，上面雕刻棕树和炼子；
3.en: He paneled the main hall with pine and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.

3.zh: 又用宝石装饰殿墙，使殿华美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
3.en: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.

3.zh: 又用金子贴殿和殿的栋梁 、 门槛 、 墙壁 、 门扇；墙上雕刻基路伯。
3.en: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.

3.zh: 又建造至圣所，长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，宽也是二十肘；贴上精金，共用金子六百他连得。
3.en: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple-twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.

3.zh: 金钉重五十舍客勒。楼房都贴上金子。
3.en: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.

3.zh: 在至圣所按造像的法子造两个基路伯，用金子包裹。
3.en: In the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.

3.zh: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长二十肘。这基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨著殿这边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与那基路伯翅膀相接。
3.en: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the temple wall, while its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub.

3.zh: 那基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨著殿那边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与这基路伯的翅膀相接。
3.en: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.

3.zh: 两个基路伯张开翅膀，共长二十肘，面向外殿而立。
3.en: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.

3.zh: 又用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线和细麻织幔子，在其上绣出基路伯来。
3.en: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.

3.zh: 在殿前造了两根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱顶高五肘。
3.en: In the front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital on top measuring five cubits.

3.zh: 又照圣所内炼子的样式做炼子，安在柱顶上；又做一百石榴，安在炼子上。
3.en: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.

3.zh: 将两根柱子立在殿前，一根在右边，一根在左边；右边的起名叫雅斤，左边的起名叫波阿斯。
3.en: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

4.zh: 他又制造一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘；
4.en: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

4.zh: 又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘；
4.en: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

4.zh: 海周围有野瓜 ( 原文作牛 ) 的样式，每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的；
4.en: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it-ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

4.zh: 有十二只铜牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾向内；
4.en: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

4.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容三千罢特；
4.en: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.

4.zh: 又制造十个盆：五个放在右边，五个放在左边，献燔祭所用之物都洗在其内；但海是为祭司沐浴的。
4.en: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.

4.zh: 他又照所定的样式造十个金灯台放在殿里：五个在右边，五个在左边；
4.en: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.

4.zh: 又造十张桌子放在殿里：五张在右边，五张在左边；又造一百个金碗；
4.en: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.

4.zh: 又建立祭司院和大院，并院门，用铜包裹门扇；
4.en: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.

4.zh: 将海安在殿门的右边，就是南边。
4.en: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.

4.zh: 户兰又造了盆 、 铲 、 碗。这样，他为所罗门王做完了神殿的工。
4.en: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:

4.zh: 所造的就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶，并两个盖柱顶的网子
4.en: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

4.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上 〈 每网两行盖著两个柱上如球的顶 〉 。
4.en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

4.zh: 盆座和其上的盆，
4.en: the stands with their basins;

4.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛，
4.en: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;

4.zh: 盆 、 铲子 、 肉锸子，与耶和华殿里的一切器皿，都是巧匠户兰用光亮的铜为所罗门王造成的，
4.en: the pots, shovels, meat forks and all related articles. All the objects that Huram-Abi made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of polished bronze.

4.zh: 是在约但平原疏割和撒利但中间藉胶泥铸成的。
4.en: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

4.zh: 所罗门制造的这一切甚多，铜的轻重无法可查。
4.en: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze was not determined.

4.zh: 所罗门又造神殿里的金坛和陈设饼的桌子，
4.en: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God's temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;

4.zh: 并精金的灯台和灯盏，可以照例点在内殿前。
4.en: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;

4.zh: 灯台上的花和灯盏，并蜡剪都是金的，且是纯金的；
4.en: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);

4.zh: 又用精金制造镊子 、 盘子 、 调羹 、 火鼎。至于殿门和至圣所的门扇，并殿的门扇，都是金子妆饰的。
4.en: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.

5.zh: 所罗门做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在神殿的府库里。
5.en: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated-the silver and gold and all the furnishings-and he placed them in the treasuries of God's temple.

5.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老 、 各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城 ─ 就是锡安 ─ 运上来。
5.en: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord 's covenant from Zion, the City of David.

5.zh: 于是以色列众人在七月节前都聚集到王那里。
5.en: And all the men of Israel came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.

5.zh: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起约柜。
5.en: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,

5.zh: 祭司利未人将约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。
5.en: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests, who were Levites, carried them up;

5.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。
5.en: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

5.zh: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
5.en: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord 's covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

5.zh: 基路伯张著翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。
5.en: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and covered the ark and its carrying poles.

5.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。
5.en: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

5.zh: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。
5.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

5.zh: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。
5.en: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.

5.zh: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨 、 希幔 、 耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹 、 鼓瑟 、 弹琴，同著他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。
5.en: All the Levites who were musicians-Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives-stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

5.zh: 吹号的 、 歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号 、 敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华说：耶和华本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！那时，耶和华的殿有云充满，
5.en: The trumpeters and singers joined in unison, as with one voice, to give praise and thanks to the Lord . Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, they raised their voices in praise to the Lord and sang: "He is good; his love endures forever." Then the temple of the Lord was filled with a cloud,

5.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了神的殿。
5.en: and the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the temple of God.

6.zh: 那时，所罗门说：耶和华曾说他必住在幽暗之处。
6.en: Then Solomon said, "The Lord hassaid that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

6.zh: 但我已经建造殿宇作你的居所，为你永远的住处。
6.en: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."

6.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。
6.en: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

6.zh: 所罗门说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。
6.en: Then he said: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,

6.zh: 他说：自从我领我民出埃及地以来，我未曾在以色列众支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，也未曾拣选一人作我民以色列的君；
6.en: 'Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built for my Name to be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be the leader over my people Israel.

6.zh: 但选择耶路撒冷为我名的居所，又拣选大卫治理我民以色列。
6.en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.'

6.zh: 所罗门说：我父大卫曾立意要为耶和华 ─ 以色列神的名建殿，
6.en: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

6.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：你立意要为我的名建殿，这意思甚好；
6.en: But the Lord said to my father David, 'Because it was in your heart to build a temple for my Name, you did well to have this in your heart.

6.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。
6.en: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, who is your own flesh and blood-he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.'

6.zh: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，是照耶和华所说的，又为耶和华 ─ 以色列神的名建造了殿。
6.en: "The Lord has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

6.zh: 我将约柜安置在其中，柜内有耶和华的约，就是他与以色列人所立的约。
6.en: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel."

6.zh: 所罗门当著以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，举起手来，
6.en: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

6.zh: 〈 所罗门曾造一个铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，放在院中 〉 就站在台上，当著以色列的会众跪下，向天举手，
6.en: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

6.zh: 说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；
6.en: He said: "O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth-you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

6.zh: 向你仆人 ─ 我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。
6.en: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it-as it is today.

6.zh: 耶和华 ─ 以色列的神啊，你所应许你仆人 ─ 我父大卫的话说：你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。现在求你应验这话。
6.en: "Now Lord , God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.'

6.zh: 耶和华 ─ 以色列的神啊，求你成就向你仆人大卫所应许的话。
6.en: And now, O Lord , God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.

6.zh: 神果真与世人同住在地上么？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？
6.en: "But will God really dwell on earth with men? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

6.zh: 惟求耶和华 ─ 我的神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人在你面前的祈祷呼吁。
6.en: Yet give attention to your servant's prayer and his plea for mercy, O Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.

6.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。
6.en: May your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, this place of which you said you would put your Name there. May you hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

6.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你从天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
6.en: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

6.zh: 人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿，在你的坛前起誓，
6.en: "When a man wrongs his neighbor and is required to take an oath and he comes and swears the oath before your altar in this temple,

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。
6.en: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, repaying the guilty by bringing down on his own head what he has done. Declare the innocent not guilty and so establish his innocence.

6.zh: 你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又回心转意承认你的名，在这殿里向你祈求祷告，
6.en: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and confess your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖之地。
6.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their fathers.

6.zh: 你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨，他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
6.en: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and confess your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

6.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你民以色列的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。
6.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

6.zh: 国中若有饥荒 、 瘟疫 、 旱风 、 霉烂 、 蝗虫 、 蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境，围困城邑，无论遭遇甚么灾祸疾病，
6.en: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

6.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉灾祸甚苦，向这殿举手，无论祈求甚么，祷告甚么，
6.en: and when a prayer or plea is made by any of your people Israel-each one aware of his afflictions and pains, and spreading out his hands toward this temple-

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），
6.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with each man according to all he does, since you know his heart (for you alone know the hearts of men),

6.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
6.en: so that they will fear you and walk in your ways all the time they live in the land you gave our fathers.

6.zh: 论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来，向这殿祷告，
6.en: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm-when he comes and prays toward this temple,

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听，照著外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一样，又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。
6.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

6.zh: 你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向你所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
6.en: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
6.en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

6.zh: 你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到或远或近之地；
6.en: "When they sin against you-for there is no one who does not sin-and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;

6.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了；
6.en: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, 'We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly';

6.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
6.en: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their fathers, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听你民的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免他们的过犯。
6.en: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.

6.zh: 我的神啊，现在求你睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
6.en: "Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

6.zh: 耶和华神啊，求你起来，和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所。耶和华神啊，愿你的祭司披上救恩；愿你的圣民蒙福欢乐。
6.en: "Now arise, O Lord God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, may your saints rejoice in your goodness.

6.zh: 耶和华神啊，求你不要厌弃你的受膏者，要记念向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。
6.en: O Lord God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember the great love promised to David your servant."

7.zh: 所罗门祈祷已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿；
7.en: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

7.zh: 因耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华殿，所以祭司不能进殿。
7.en: The priests could not enter the temple of the Lord because the glory of the Lord filled it.

7.zh: 那火降下 、 耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地俯伏叩拜，称谢耶和华说：耶和华本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！
7.en: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the Lord above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, "He is good; his love endures forever."

7.zh: 王和众民在耶和华面前献祭。
7.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord .

7.zh: 所罗门王用牛二万二千，羊十二万献祭。这样，王和众民为神的殿行奉献之礼。
7.en: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.

7.zh: 祭司侍立，各供其职；利未人也拿著耶和华的乐器，就是大卫王造出来 、 藉利未人颂赞耶和华的。（他的慈爱永远长存！）祭司在众人面前吹号，以色列人都站立。
7.en: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the Lord 's musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the Lord and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, "His love endures forever." Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.

7.zh: 所罗门因他所造的铜坛容不下燔祭 、 素祭，和脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
7.en: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.

7.zh: 那时所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成为大会，守节七日。
7.en: So Solomon observed the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him-a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.

7.zh: 第八日设立严肃会，行奉献坛的礼七日，守节七日。
7.en: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.

7.zh: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民；他们因见耶和华向大卫和所罗门与他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。
7.en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.

7.zh: 所罗门造成了耶和华殿和王宫；在耶和华殿和王宫凡他心中所要做的，都顺顺利利地做成了。
7.en: When Solomon had finished the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the Lord and in his own palace,

7.zh: 夜间耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：我已听了你的祷告，也选择这地方作为祭祀我的殿宇。
7.en: the Lord appeared to him at night and said: "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.

7.zh: 我若使天闭塞不下雨，或使蝗虫吃这地的出产，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
7.en: "When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,

7.zh: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑 、 祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
7.en: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then will I hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

7.zh: 我必睁眼看 、 侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
7.en: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

7.zh: 现在我已选择这殿，分别为圣，使我的名永在其中，我的眼 、 我的心也必常在那里。
7.en: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

7.zh: 你若在我面前效法你父大卫所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，
7.en: "As for you, if you walk before me as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,

7.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位，正如我与你父大卫所立的约，说：你的子孙必不断人作以色列的王。
7.en: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to rule over Israel.'

7.zh: 倘若你们转去丢弃我指示你们的律例诫命，去事奉敬拜别神，
7.en: "But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

7.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上拔出根来，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使他在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。
7.en: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

7.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶说：耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？
7.en: And though this temple is now so imposing, all who pass by will be appalled and say, 'Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?'

7.zh: 人必回答说：是因此地的人离弃耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神，就是领他们出埃及地的神，去亲近别神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。
7.en: People will answer, 'Because they have forsaken the Lord , the God of their fathers, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them- that is why he brought all this disaster on them.' "

8.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。
8.en: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the Lord and his own palace,

8.zh: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。
8.en: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.

8.zh: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。
8.en: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.

8.zh: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，
8.en: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.

8.zh: 又建造上伯和仑 、 下伯和仑作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩；
8.en: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,

8.zh: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷 、 利巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。
8.en: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses -whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

8.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人，
8.en: All the people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites),

8.zh: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。
8.en: that is, their descendants remaining in the land, whom the Israelites had not destroyed-these Solomon conscripted for his slave labor force, as it is to this day.

8.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆做工，乃是作他的战士 、 军长的统领 、 车兵长 、 马兵长。
8.en: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

8.zh: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。
8.en: They were also King Solomon's chief officials-two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.

8.zh: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为他建造的宫里；因所罗门说：耶和华约柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。
8.en: Solomon brought Pharaoh's daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, "My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the Lord has entered are holy."

8.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭；
8.en: On the altar of the Lord that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the Lord ,

8.zh: 又遵著摩西的吩咐在安息日 、 月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节 、 七七节 、 住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。
8.en: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons and the three annual feasts-the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles.

8.zh: 所罗门照著他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前做每日所当做的；又派守门的按著班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。
8.en: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day's requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.

8.zh: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。
8.en: They did not deviate from the king's commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.

8.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。
8.en: All Solomon's work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid until its completion. So the temple of the Lord was finished.

8.zh: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬迦别和以禄去。
8.en: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.

8.zh: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同著所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。
8.en: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own officers, men who knew the sea. These, with Solomon's men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

9.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门；跟随他的人甚多，又有骆驼驮著香料 、 宝石，和许多金子。他来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。
9.en: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan-with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones-she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.

9.zh: 所罗门将他所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白 、 不能答的。
9.en: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.

9.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室 、
9.en: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,

9.zh: 席上的珍馐美味 、 群臣分列而坐 、 仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰 、 酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，
9.en: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.

9.zh: 对王说：我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！
9.en: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

9.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告诉我的，还不到一半；你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。
9.en: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.

9.zh: 你的群臣 、 你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。
9.en: How happy your men must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

9.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华 ─ 你的神作王；因为你的神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。
9.en: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the Lord your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."

9.zh: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王；他送给王的香料，以后再没有这样的。
9.en: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

9.zh: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木 ( 或作乌木；下同 ) 和宝石来。
9.en: (The men of Hiram and the men of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.

9.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做台，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟；犹大地从来没有见过这样的。
9.en: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)

9.zh: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还他礼物，另外照他一切所要所求的，都送给他。于是女王和他臣仆转回本国去了。
9.en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

9.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，
9.en: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,

9.zh: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且亚拉伯诸王与属国的省长都带金银给所罗门。
9.en: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.

9.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
9.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred bekas of hammered gold went into each shield.

9.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在利巴嫩林宫里。
9.en: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred bekas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

9.zh: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。
9.en: Then the king made a great throne inlaid with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.

9.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。
9.en: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

9.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。
9.en: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

9.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，利巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了甚么。
9.en: All King Solomon's goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon's day.

9.zh: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去；他施船只三年一次装载金 、 银 、 象牙 、 猿猴 、 孔雀回来。
9.en: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram's men. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

9.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。
9.en: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

9.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听神赐给他智慧的话。
9.en: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

9.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器 、 银器 、 衣服 、 军械 、 香料 、 骡马，每年有一定之例。
9.en: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift-articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

9.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
9.en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

9.zh: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
9.en: He ruled over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.

9.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
9.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

9.zh: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。
9.en: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.

9.zh: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上么？
9.en: As for the other events of Solomon's reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

9.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
9.en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

9.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。
9.en: Then he rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

10.zh: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列人都到了示剑，要立他作王。
10.en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all the Israelites had gone there to make him king.

10.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里；他听见这事，就从埃及回来。
10.en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

10.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他，他就和以色列众人来见罗波安，对他说：
10.en: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

10.zh: 你父亲使我们负重轭做苦工，现在求你使我们做的苦工负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。
10.en: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."

10.zh: 罗波安对他们说：第三日再来见我罢！民就去了。
10.en: Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people went away.

10.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：你们给我出个甚么主意，我好回覆这民。
10.en: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.

10.zh: 老年人对他说：王若恩待这民，使他们喜悦，用好话回覆他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。
10.en: They replied, "If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."

10.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大 、 在他面前侍立的少年人商议，
10.en: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

10.zh: 说：这民对我说：你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些；你们给我出个甚么主意，我好回覆他们。
10.en: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, 'Lighten the yoke your father put on us'?"

10.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说：这民对王说：你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些；王要对他们如此说：我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗；
10.en: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "Tell the people who have said to you, 'Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter'-tell them, 'My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.

10.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。
10.en: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.' "

10.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵著罗波安王所说你们第三日再来见我的那话，第三日他们果然来了。
10.en: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."

10.zh: 罗波安王用严厉的话回覆他们，不用老年人所出的主意，
10.en: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,

10.zh: 照著少年人所出的主意对他们说：我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。
10.en: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."

10.zh: 王不肯依从百姓；这事乃出于神，为要应验耶和华藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
10.en: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

10.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说：我们与大卫有甚么分儿呢？与耶西的儿子并没有关涉！以色列人哪，各回各家去罢！大卫家啊，自己顾自己罢！于是，以色列众人都回自己家里去了。
10.en: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse's son? To your tents, O Israel! Look after your own house, O David!" So all the Israelites went home.

10.zh: 惟独住在犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。
10.en: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

10.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
10.en: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

10.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。
10.en: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

11.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列人争战，好将国夺回再归自己。
11.en: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the house of Judah and Benjamin-a hundred and eighty thousand fighting men-to make war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.

11.zh: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅说：
11.en: But this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:

11.zh: 你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和住犹大 、 便雅悯的以色列众人说，
11.en: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin,

11.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们不可上去与你们的弟兄争战，各归各家去罢！因为这事出于我。众人就听从耶和华的话归回，不去与耶罗波安争战。
11.en: 'This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.' " So they obeyed the words of the Lord and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.

11.zh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，
11.en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:

11.zh: 为保障修筑伯利恒 、 以坦 、 提哥亚 、
11.en: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

11.zh: 伯夙 、 梭哥 、 亚杜兰 、
11.en: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

11.zh: 迦特 、 玛利沙 、 西弗 、
11.en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

11.zh: 亚多莱音 、 拉吉 、 亚西加 、
11.en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

11.zh: 琐拉 、 亚雅仑 、 希伯仑。这都是犹大和便雅悯的坚固城。
11.en: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

11.zh: 罗波安又坚固各处的保障，在其中安置军长，又预备下粮食 、 油 、 酒。
11.en: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.

11.zh: 他在各城里预备盾牌和枪，且使城极其坚固。犹大和便雅悯都归了他。
11.en: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.

11.zh: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都从四方来归罗波安。
11.en: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.

11.zh: 利未人撇下他们的郊野和产业，来到犹大与耶路撒冷，是因耶罗波安和他的儿子拒绝他们，不许他们供祭司职分事奉耶和华。
11.en: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the Lord .

11.zh: 耶罗波安为邱坛 、 为鬼魔 ( 原文作公山羊 ) 、 为自己所铸造的牛犊设立祭司。
11.en: And he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.

11.zh: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意寻求耶和华 ─ 以色列神的，都随从利未人，来到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神。
11.en: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their fathers.

11.zh: 这样，就坚固犹大国，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛三年，因为他们三年遵行大卫和所罗门的道。
11.en: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, walking in the ways of David and Solomon during this time.

11.zh: 罗波安娶大卫儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉为妻，又娶耶西儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩为妻。
11.en: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David's son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse's son Eliab.

11.zh: 从他生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施 、 示玛利雅 、 撒罕。
11.en: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.

11.zh: 后来又娶押沙龙的女儿玛迦 ( 十三章二节作乌列的女儿米该雅 ) ，从他生了亚比雅 、 亚太 、 细撒 、 示罗密。
11.en: Then he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.

11.zh: 罗波安娶十八个妻，立六十个妾，生二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的女儿玛迦，比爱别的妻妾更甚。
11.en: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

11.zh: 罗波安立玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他弟兄中为首，因为想要立他接续作王。
11.en: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah to be the chief prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.

11.zh: 罗波安办事精明，使他众子分散在犹大和便雅悯全地各坚固城里，又赐他们许多粮食，为他们多寻妻子。
11.en: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.

12.zh: 罗波安的国坚立，他强盛的时候就离弃耶和华的律法，以色列人也都随从他。
12.en: After Rehoboam's position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the Lord .

12.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为王和民得罪了耶和华。
12.en: Because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.

12.zh: 示撒带战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，并且跟从他出埃及的路比人 、 苏基人，和古实人，多得不可胜数。
12.en: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,

12.zh: 他攻取了犹大的坚固城，就来到耶路撒冷。
12.en: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

12.zh: 那时，犹大的首领因为示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示玛雅去见罗波安和众首领，对他们说：耶和华如此说：你们离弃了我，所以我使你们落在示撒手里。
12.en: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the Lord says, 'You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.' "

12.zh: 于是王和以色列的众首领都自卑说：耶和华是公义的。
12.en: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is just."

12.zh: 耶和华见他们自卑，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅说：他们既自卑，我必不灭绝他们；必使他们略得拯救，我不藉著示撒的手将我的怒气倒在耶路撒冷。
12.en: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: "Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.

12.zh: 然而他们必作示撒的仆人，好叫他们知道，服事我与服事外邦人有何分别。
12.en: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands."

12.zh: 于是，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。
12.en: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.

12.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。
12.en: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

12.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。
12.en: Whenever the king went to the Lord 's temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.

12.zh: 王自卑的时候，耶和华的怒气就转消了，不将他灭尽，并且在犹大中间也有善益的事。
12.en: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord 's anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.

12.zh: 罗波安王自强，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
12.en: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother's name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

12.zh: 罗波安行恶，因他不立定心意寻求耶和华。
12.en: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the Lord .

12.zh: 罗波安所行的事，自始至终不都写在先知示玛雅和先见易多的史记上么？罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。
12.en: As for the events of Rehoboam's reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

12.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚比雅接续他作王。
12.en: Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

13.zh: 耶罗波安王十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王，
13.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,

13.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫米该亚 ( 又作玛迦 ) ，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。亚比雅常与耶罗波安争战。
13.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother's name was Maacah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

13.zh: 有一次亚比雅率领挑选的兵四十万摆阵，都是勇敢的战士；耶罗波安也挑选大能的勇士八十万，对亚比雅摆阵。
13.en: Abijah went into battle with a force of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.

13.zh: 亚比雅站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说：耶罗波安和以色列众人哪，要听我说！
13.en: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!

13.zh: 耶和华 ─ 以色列的神曾立盐 ( 即不废坏的意思 ) 约，将以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道么？
13.en: Don't you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?

13.zh: 无奈大卫儿子所罗门的臣仆 、 尼八儿子耶罗波安起来背叛他的主人。
13.en: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.

13.zh: 有些无赖的匪徒聚集跟从他，逞强攻击所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还幼弱，不能抵挡他们。
13.en: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.

13.zh: 现在你们有意抗拒大卫子孙手下所治耶和华的国，你们的人也甚多，你们那里又有耶罗波安为你们所造当作神的金牛犊。
13.en: "And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the Lord , which is in the hands of David's descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.

13.zh: 你们不是驱逐耶和华的祭司亚伦的后裔和利未人么？不是照著外邦人的恶俗为自己立祭司么？无论何人牵一只公牛犊 、 七只公绵羊将自己分别出来，就可作虚无之神的祭司。
13.en: But didn't you drive out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.

13.zh: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的神，我们并没有离弃他。我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的后裔，并有利未人各尽其职，
13.en: "As for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the Lord are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.

13.zh: 每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，烧美香，又在精金的桌子上摆陈设饼；又有金灯台和灯盏，每晚点起，因为我们遵守耶和华 ─ 我们神的命；惟有你们离弃了他。
13.en: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord . They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the Lord our God. But you have forsaken him.

13.zh: 率领我们的是神，我们这里也有神的祭司拿号向你们吹出大声。以色列人哪，不要与耶和华 ─ 你们列祖的神争战，因你们必不能亨通。
13.en: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. Men of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed."

13.zh: 耶罗波安却在犹大人的后头设伏兵。这样，以色列人在犹大人的前头，伏兵在犹大人的后头。
13.en: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.

13.zh: 犹大人回头观看，见前后都有敌兵，就呼求耶和华，祭司也吹号。
13.en: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the Lord . The priests blew their trumpets

13.zh: 于是犹大人呐喊；犹大人呐喊的时候，神就使耶罗波安和以色列众人败在亚比雅与犹大人面前。
13.en: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

13.zh: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑，神将他们交在犹大人手里。
13.en: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.

13.zh: 亚比雅和他的军兵大大杀戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十万。
13.en: Abijah and his men inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel's able men.

13.zh: 那时，以色列人被制伏了，犹大人得胜，是因倚靠耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神。
13.en: The men of Israel were subdued on that occasion, and the men of Judah were victorious because they relied on the Lord , the God of their fathers.

13.zh: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，攻取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属伯特利的镇市，耶沙拿和属耶沙拿的镇市，以法拉音 ( 或作以弗伦 ) 和属以法拉音的镇市。
13.en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.

13.zh: 亚比雅在世的时候，耶罗波安不能再强盛；耶和华攻击他，他就死了。
13.en: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down and he died.

13.zh: 亚比雅却渐渐强盛，娶妻妾十四个，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。
13.en: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

13.zh: 亚比雅其余的事和他的言行都写在先知易多的传上。
13.en: The other events of Abijah's reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.

14.zh: 亚比雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒年间，国中太平十年。
14.en: And Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.

14.zh: 亚撒行耶和华 ─ 他神眼中看为善为正的事，
14.en: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.

14.zh: 除掉外邦神的坛和邱坛，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，
14.en: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

14.zh: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神，遵行他的律法 、 诫命；
14.en: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their fathers, and to obey his laws and commands.

14.zh: 又在犹大各城邑除掉邱坛和日像，那时国享太平；
14.en: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.

14.zh: 又在犹大建造了几座坚固城。国中太平数年，没有战争，因为耶和华赐他平安。
14.en: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the Lord gave him rest.

14.zh: 他对犹大人说：我们要建造这些城邑，四围筑墙，盖楼，安门，做闩；地还属我们，是因寻求耶和华 ─ 我们的神；我们既寻求他，他就赐我们四境平安。于是建造城邑，诸事亨通。
14.en: "Let us build up these towns," he said to Judah, "and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the Lord our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.

14.zh: 亚撒的军兵，出自犹大拿盾牌拿枪的三十万人；出自便雅悯拿盾牌拉弓的二十八万人。这都是大能的勇士。
14.en: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.

14.zh: 有古实王谢拉率领军兵一百万，战车三百辆，出来攻击犹大人，到了玛利沙。
14.en: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with a vast army and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.

14.zh: 于是亚撒出去与他迎敌，就在玛利沙的洗法谷彼此摆阵。
14.en: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.

14.zh: 亚撒呼求耶和华 ─ 他的神说：耶和华啊，惟有你能帮助软弱的，胜过强盛的。耶和华 ─ 我们的神啊，求你帮助我们；因为我们仰赖你，奉你的名来攻击这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的神，不要容人胜过你。
14.en: Then Asa called to the Lord his God and said, "Lord , there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O Lord our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. O Lord , you are our God; do not let man prevail against you."

14.zh: 于是耶和华使古实人败在亚撒和犹大人面前，古实人就逃跑了；
14.en: The Lord struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,

14.zh: 亚撒和跟随他的军兵追赶他们，直到基拉耳。古实人被杀的甚多，不能再强盛，因为败在耶和华与他军兵面前。犹大人就夺了许多财物，
14.en: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the Lord and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.

14.zh: 又打破基拉耳四围的城邑；耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掳掠一空，因其中的财物甚多，
14.en: They destroyed all the villages around Gerar, for the terror of the Lord had fallen upon them. They plundered all these villages, since there was much booty there.

14.zh: 又毁坏了群畜的圈，夺取许多的羊和骆驼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
14.en: They also attacked the camps of the herdsmen and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

15.zh: 神的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。
15.en: The Spirit of God came uponAzariah son of Oded.

15.zh: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说：亚撒和犹大 、 便雅悯众人哪，要听我说：你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求他，就必寻见；你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。
15.en: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

15.zh: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了；
15.en: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach and without the law.

15.zh: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华 ─ 以色列的神，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。
15.en: But in their distress they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.

15.zh: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱；
15.en: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.

15.zh: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为神用各样灾难扰乱他们。
15.en: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.

15.zh: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。
15.en: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded."

15.zh: 亚撒听见这话和俄德儿子先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大 、 便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华殿的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛；
15.en: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the Lord that was in front of the portico of the Lord 's temple.

15.zh: 又招聚犹大 、 便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人 、 玛拿西人 、 西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华 ─ 他的神与他同在。
15.en: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

15.zh: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。
15.en: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's reign.

15.zh: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只 、 羊七千只献给耶和华。
15.en: At that time they sacrificed to the Lord seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.

15.zh: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神。
15.en: They entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their fathers, with all their heart and soul.

15.zh: 凡不寻求耶和华 ─ 以色列神的，无论大小 、 男女，必被治死。
15.en: All who would not seek the Lord , the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.

15.zh: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。
15.en: They took an oath to the Lord with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.

15.zh: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜；因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。
15.en: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the Lord gave them rest on every side.

15.zh: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因他造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下他的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。
15.en: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole. Asa cut the pole down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

15.zh: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。
15.en: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa's heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.

15.zh: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣 、 与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到神的殿里。
15.en: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

15.zh: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。
15.en: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign.

16.zh: 亚撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。
16.en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

16.zh: 于是亚撒从耶和华殿和王宫的府库里拿出金银来，送与住大马色的亚兰王便哈达，说：
16.en: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the Lord 's temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

16.zh: 你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送给你，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。
16.en: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."

16.zh: 便哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云 、 但 、 亚伯玛音，和拿弗他利一切的积货城。
16.en: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.

16.zh: 巴沙听见就停工，不修筑拉玛了。
16.en: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

16.zh: 于是亚撒王率领犹大众人，将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头 、 木头都运去，用以修筑迦巴和米斯巴。
16.en: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.

16.zh: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说：因你仰赖亚兰王，没有仰赖耶和华 ─ 你的神，所以亚兰王的军兵脱离了你的手。
16.en: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: "Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

16.zh: 古实人 、 路比人的军队不是甚大么？战车马兵不是极多么？只因你仰赖耶和华，他便将他们交在你手里。
16.en: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a mighty army with great numbers of chariots and horsemen ? Yet when you relied on the Lord , he delivered them into your hand.

16.zh: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧；此后，你必有争战的事。
16.en: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war."

16.zh: 亚撒因此恼恨先见，将他囚在监里。那时亚撒也虐待一些人民。
16.en: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.

16.zh: 亚撒所行的事，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
16.en: The events of Asa's reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

16.zh: 亚撒作王三十九年，他脚上有病，而且甚重。病的时候没有求耶和华，只求医生。
16.en: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the Lord , but only from the physicians.

16.zh: 他作王四十一年而死，与他列祖同睡，
16.en: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his fathers.

16.zh: 葬在大卫城自己所凿的坟墓里，放在床上，其床堆满各样馨香的香料，就是按做香的作法调和的香料，又为他烧了许多的物件。
16.en: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.

17.zh: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，
17.en: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.

17.zh: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。
17.en: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

17.zh: 耶和华与约沙法同在；因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，
17.en: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because in his early years he walked in the ways his father David had followed. He did not consult the Baals

17.zh: 只寻求他父亲的神，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。
17.en: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.

17.zh: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡；约沙法大有尊荣资财。
17.en: The Lord established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.

17.zh: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切邱坛和木偶。
17.en: His heart was devoted to the ways of the Lord ; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.

17.zh: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便亥伊勒 、 俄巴底 、 撒迦利雅 、 拿坦业 、 米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。
17.en: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.

17.zh: 同著他们有利未人示玛雅 、 尼探雅 、 西巴第雅 、 亚撒黑 、 示米拉末 、 约拿单 、 亚多尼雅 、 多比雅 、 驼巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛 、 约兰同著他们。
17.en: With them were certain Levites-Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob- Adonijah-and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

17.zh: 他们带著耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。
17.en: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the Lord ; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.

17.zh: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。
17.en: The fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not make war with Jehoshaphat.

17.zh: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。亚拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。
17.en: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.

17.zh: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。
17.en: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah

17.zh: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。
17.en: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.

17.zh: 他们的数目，按著宗族，记在下面：犹大族的，千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士 ─ 三十万；
17.en: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;

17.zh: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领大能的勇士 ─ 二十八万；
其次是，细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅 〈 他为耶和华牺牲自己 〉 率领大能的勇士 ─ 二十万。
17.en: next, Amasiah son of Zicri, who volunteered himself for the service of the Lord , with 200,000.

17.zh: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领，拿弓箭和盾牌的 ─ 二十万；
17.en: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;

17.zh: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的 ─ 十八万。
17.en: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.

17.zh: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。
17.en: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

18.zh: 约沙法大有尊荣资财，就与亚哈结亲。
18.en: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

18.zh: 过了几年，他下到撒玛利亚去见亚哈；亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了许多牛羊，劝他与自己同去攻取基列的拉末。
18.en: Some years later he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.

18.zh: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法说：你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末么？他回答说：你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，必与你同去争战。
18.en: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied, "I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war."

18.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说：请你先求问耶和华。
18.en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the Lord ."

18.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知四百人，问他们说：我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？他们说：可以上去，因为神必将那城交在王的手里。
18.en: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets-four hundred men-and asked them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Go," they answered, "for God will give it into the king's hand."

18.zh: 约沙法说：这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他么？
18.en: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?"

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅。我们可以托他求问耶和华，只是我恨他；因为他指著我所说的预言，不说吉语，常说凶言。约沙法说：王不必这样说。
18.en: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say that," Jehoshaphat replied.

18.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。
18.en: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

18.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒玛利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
18.en: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance to the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

18.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：耶和华如此说：你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。
18.en: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns, and he declared, "This is what the Lord says: 'With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.' "

18.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。
18.en: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king's hand."

18.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说：众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。
18.en: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, "Look, as one man the other prophets are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably."

18.zh: 米该雅说：我指著永生的耶和华起誓，我的神说甚么，我就说甚么。
18.en: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what my God says."

18.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？他说：可以上去，必然得胜，敌人必交在你们手里。
18.en: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for they will be given into your hand."

18.zh: 王对他说：我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？
18.en: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"

18.zh: 米该雅说：我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。
18.en: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, 'These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.' "

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：我岂没有告诉你，这人指著我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言么？
18.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn't I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"

18.zh: 米该雅说：你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
18.en: Micaiah continued, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the host of heaven standing on his right and on his left.

18.zh: 耶和华说：谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？这个就这样说，那个就那样说。
18.en: And the Lord said, 'Who will entice Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?' "One suggested this, and another that.

18.zh: 随后，有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前说：我去引诱他。耶和华问他说：你用何法呢？
18.en: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, 'I will entice him.' " 'By what means?' the Lord asked.

18.zh: 他说：我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。耶和华说：这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行罢！
18.en: " 'I will go and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,' he said. " 'You will succeed in enticing him,' said the Lord . 'Go and do it.'

18.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。
18.en: "So now the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you."

18.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来打米该雅的脸，说：耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？
18.en: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.

18.zh: 米该雅说：你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。
18.en: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."

18.zh: 以色列王说：将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说：
18.en: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king's son,

18.zh: 王如此说：把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。
18.en: and say, 'This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.' "

18.zh: 米该雅说：你若能平安回来，那就是耶和华没有藉我说这话了；又说：众民哪，你们都要听！
18.en: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"

18.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
18.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。于是以色列王改装，他们就上阵去了。
18.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

18.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐车兵长说：他们的兵将，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。
18.en: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."

18.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法便说，这必是以色列王，就转过去与他争战。约沙法一呼喊，耶和华就帮助他，神又感动他们离开他。
18.en: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "This is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him. God drew them away from him,

18.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。
18.en: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.

18.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵罢！
18.en: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told the chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I've been wounded."

18.zh: 那日阵势越战越猛，以色列王勉强站在车上抵挡亚兰人，直到晚上。约在日落的时候，王就死了。
18.en: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.

19.zh: 犹大王约沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宫里去了。
19.en: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,

19.zh: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎接约沙法王，对他说：你岂当帮助恶人，爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒临到你。
19.en: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ? Because of this, the wrath of the Lord is upon you.

19.zh: 然而你还有善行，因你从国中除掉木偶，立定心意寻求神。
19.en: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God."

19.zh: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，以后又出巡民间，从别是巴直到以法莲山地，引导民归向耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神；
19.en: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord , the God of their fathers.

19.zh: 又在犹大国中遍地的坚固城里设立审判官，
19.en: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

19.zh: 对他们说：你们办事应当谨慎；因为你们判断不是为人，乃是为耶和华。判断的时候，他必与你们同在。
19.en: He told them, "Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for man but for the Lord , who is with you whenever you give a verdict.

19.zh: 现在你们应当敬畏耶和华，谨慎办事；因为耶和华 ─ 我们的神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。
19.en: Now let the fear of the Lord be upon you. Judge carefully, for with the Lord our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery."

19.zh: 约沙法从利未人和祭司，并以色列族长中派定人，在耶路撒冷为耶和华判断，听民间的争讼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
19.en: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the Lord and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

19.zh: 约沙法嘱咐他们说：你们当敬畏耶和华，忠心诚实办事。
19.en: He gave them these orders: "You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the Lord .

19.zh: 住在各城里你们的弟兄，若有争讼的事来到你们这里，或为流血，或犯律法 、 诫命 、 律例 、 典章，你们要警戒他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致他的忿怒临到你们和你们的弟兄；这样行，你们就没有罪了。
19.en: In every case that comes before you from your fellow countrymen who live in the cities-whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or ordinances-you are to warn them not to sin against the Lord ; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not sin.

19.zh: 凡属耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们；凡属王的事，有犹大支派的族长以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们；在你们面前有利未人作官长。你们应当壮胆办事，愿耶和华与善人同在。
19.en: "Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the Lord , and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the Lord be with those who do well."

20.zh: 此后，摩押人和亚扪人，又有米乌尼人，一同来攻击约沙法。
20.en: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to make war on Jehoshaphat.

20.zh: 有人来报告约沙法说：从海外亚兰 ( 又作以东 ) 那边有大军来攻击你，如今他们在哈洗逊他玛，就是隐基底。
20.en: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, "A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Sea. It is already in Hazazon Tamar" (that is, En Gedi).

20.zh: 约沙法便惧怕，定意寻求耶和华，在犹大全地宣告禁食。
20.en: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the Lord , and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

20.zh: 于是犹大人聚会，求耶和华帮助。犹大各城都有人出来寻求耶和华。
20.en: The people of Judah came together to seek help from the Lord ; indeed, they came from every town in Judah to seek him.

20.zh: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会中，站在耶和华殿的新院前，
20.en: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the Lord in the front of the new courtyard

20.zh: 说：耶和华 ─ 我们列祖的神啊，你不是天上的神么？你不是万邦万国的主宰么？在你手中有大能大力，无人能抵挡你。
20.en: and said: "O Lord , God of our fathers, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.

20.zh: 我们的神啊，你不是曾在你民以色列人面前驱逐这地的居民，将这地赐给你朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远为业么？
20.en: O our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?

20.zh: 他们住在这地，又为你的名建造圣所，说：
20.en: They have lived in it and have built in it a sanctuary for your Name, saying,

20.zh: 倘有祸患临到我们，或刀兵灾殃，或瘟疫饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿前向你呼求，你必垂听而拯救，因为你的名在这殿里。
